title: Zesty Charred Irish Beef Stew
description: A weeknight Irish dish featuring charred beef, soya milk, and paleo-friendly ingredients, cooked to perfection using sous-vide for a silky texture.
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 130 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef stew meat with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Sear the beef stew meat in a hot skillet with olive oil until charred on all sides.
Add the onion, carrots, and potatoes to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the tomato paste to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Transfer the skillet contents to a large ziplock bag and add the soya milk.
Seal the bag and cook in the sous-vide machine for 2 hours.
Remove the bag from the sous-vide machine and let it cool.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
